repair_case_idempotency_keys_succeeded_h.name: repair_case_idempotency_keys_succeeded_has_repair_case
repair_case_idempotency_keys_succeeded_h.value: status <> 'SUCCEEDED' OR repair_case_id IS NOT NULL

repair_case_approvals_decision_metadata.name: repair_case_approvals_decision_metadata
repair_case_approvals_decision_metadata.value:
(status = 'REQUESTED' AND decided_by_user_id IS NULL AND decided_at IS NULL AND decision_reason IS NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'APPROVED' AND decided_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'REJECTED' AND decided_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND decision_reason IS NOT NULL)

shipment_approval_delegations_revocation.name: shipment_approval_delegations_revocation_metadata
shipment_approval_delegations_revocation.value:
(status = 'ACTIVE' AND revoked_by_user_id IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL)
        OR
        (status = 'REVOKED' AND revoked_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL)

procedure_case_execution_nodes_extra_tas.name: procedure_case_execution_nodes_extra_task_needs_title
procedure_case_execution_nodes_extra_tas.value: "procedure_case_execution_nodes"."procedure_template_node_id" is not null or "procedure_case_execution_nodes"."extra_task_title" is not null
